title: Focal Point: piano × ultrasound
question: Can a piano explain ultrasound? Each key is one array element; only the timing of the notes changes.
description: A solo-piano video (1:44, sound on) in which the 88 keys act as array elements. Chapters: plane wave, steering, near, mid and far focus, steer plus focus, echo with delay-and-sum, and a moving sub-aperture that builds an image pixel by pixel.
validation: Every transmit note (207) starts within 0.05 ms of the delay law of its gesture (plane wave, steering or focusing), checked against the geometry independently of the renderer; geometry and wave speed are scaled so the delays can be heard.
credit: Original composition and animation by M. Nguyen. Piano samples: Salamander Grand Piano by Alexander Holm (CC BY).
